rows.en: Investigate Enemy Base
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Obtain an Organic Plate
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: The unidentified units appearing all over are very likely connected to Drake.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: <mk(62.5,25,7,3,50)><ar(0,7,3,150)><mk(25,37.5,7,0,50)><ar(0,7,0,150)>We will now head to the Drake Army's base to investigate.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: However, the <pic(0)><cs(3)>suspected area<ce()> is wide, so it's essential that every unit search on its own.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: If any of you find the enemy base, I'm counting on you to report in at once.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Ever since Drake made contact with Dermail, I've been with the UCE, looking into the E2.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: ...I believe I must explain this to all of you.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: The E2 is <cs(1)>Aura Energy<ce()> artificially materialized into a highly concentrated energy mass.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: Its synchronizing effect is so strong it can explosively boost its host's base power.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: That versatility means it can be adapted to all kinds of weapons.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: The machines you fought before were also experimental units for it.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: Dermail had joined hands with Drake for a time, as a source of Aura Energy.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: It seems his aim was to <cs(1)>apply the E2 to machine enhancement<ce()> and gain that technology.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: A gentle rule backed by absolute military force... That is their aim.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: OZ, with its fine researchers, and Drake, with his resources, had interests that aligned.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: With his goal achieved, Dermail cut ties with Drake to keep that power to himself.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: Since coming to the Surface, I have been tracking Drake's movements, but
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: For him to join hands with wicked people of the Surface like this... It is unforgivable.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: I intend to keep pursuing Drake.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: As members of the UCE, please look into Dermail's movements.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?

rows.en: I never imagined you would be defeated... I can only say that it is deeply regrettable.
rows.speaker: Ciela Lapana?
